title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the China Banking Regulatory Commission on Further Promoting the Work of Online Enforcement Investigation and Control
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court and China Banking Regulatory Commission

Notice on Further Promoting Online Execution Inquiry and Control

Fa [2018] No. 64

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; all banking regulatory bureaus; all policy banks, large commercial banks, joint-stock commercial banks, the Postal Savings Bank of China, and all provincial rural credit unions:

For the purpose of fully implementing the "Opinions on Accelerating the Establishment of a Credit Supervision, Warning, and Punishment Mechanism for Dishonest Judgment Debtors" (Zhongban Fa [2016] No. 64) issued by the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court and the China Banking Regulatory Commission on the Development of Online Execution Inquiry, Control, and Joint Credit Punishment by People's Courts and Banking Financial Institutions" (Fa [2014] No. 266), and the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the China Banking Regulatory Commission on Jointly Issuing the 'Standards for Online Execution Inquiry and Control Work by People's Courts and Banking Financial Institutions'" (Fa [2015] No. 321); for the purpose of safeguarding judicial authority, preventing financial risks, and promoting the construction of the social credit system; the Supreme People's Court and the China Banking Regulatory Commission have decided to further advance the role of online execution inquiry, control, and joint credit punishment by people's courts and banking financial institutions. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. The 21 banks (Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, China Construction Bank, Bank of Communications, China Everbright Bank, China Minsheng Bank, Huaxia Bank, China Merchants Bank, China Guangfa Bank, Shanghai Pudong Development Bank, Agricultural Development Bank of China, China CITIC Bank, Ping An Bank, China Bohai Bank, China Zheshang Bank, Industrial Bank, China Evergrowing Bank, the Postal Savings Bank of China, the Export-Import Bank of China, and Bank of Beijing) shall launch the online freezing function and online deduction function for bank deposits before March 31, 2018.

2. The 19 banks that offer financial wealth management products (Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, China Construction Bank, Bank of Communications, China Everbright Bank, China Minsheng Bank, Huaxia Bank, China Merchants Bank, China Guangfa Bank, Shanghai Pudong Development Bank, China CITIC Bank, Ping An Bank, China Bohai Bank, China Zheshang Bank, Industrial Bank, China Evergrowing Bank, the Postal Savings Bank of China, and Bank of Beijing) shall launch the online freezing function for financial wealth management products before March 31, 2018.

3. Local banking financial institutions other than the 21 banks shall launch the online freezing function and online deduction function for bank deposits before April 30, 2018.

4. Local banking financial institutions other than the 21 banks shall complete testing with the Supreme People's Court for the inquiry and control function of financial wealth management products before March 28, 2018 (testing is required regardless of whether they offer financial wealth management products); local banking financial institutions that offer financial wealth management products shall launch the online inquiry function for financial wealth management products before May 31, 2018, and the online freezing function for financial wealth management products before June 30, 2018.

5. Banking financial institutions shall support full deduction and partial deduction of bank deposits under online freezing. After the online deduction function is launched, funds that have been frozen online shall, in principle, be deducted online.

6. When a people's court deducts bank deposits of a judgment debtor online, it shall provide the relevant "Enforcement Ruling," "Notice of Assistance in Enforcement," the enforcement officer's work credentials, and contact information; on-site deductions shall be subject to the same requirements by reference.

7. When a people's court deducts bank deposits of a judgment debtor online, it shall first take online freezing measures; the funds deducted online shall be transferred to the special account for execution funds or the case-fund account of the people's court; after freezing the funds of the judgment debtor online, the people's court shall promptly notify the judgment debtor.

8. If the online deduction by a people's court fails and funds remain stranded in the internal account of the bank, the bank shall contact the enforcement officer of the execution court to bring the "Enforcement Ruling," "Notice of Assistance in Enforcement," and work credentials to the bank for an on-site deduction.

If an out-of-area execution court entrusts the local court to handle the matter on its behalf, the entrusting court shall provide: the "Enforcement Ruling," "Notice of Assistance in Enforcement," "Letter of Entrustment for Execution," "Proof of Service" (or "Receipt"), and scanned copies of the enforcement officer's work credentials. The above legal documents shall bear the electronic seal of the entrusting court, or shall be color scans of the sealed documents. The entrusted court shall bring color prints of the above materials and the work credentials of its own enforcement officer. The bank shall provide assistance.

If an out-of-area execution court mails the originals of the "Enforcement Ruling" and "Notice of Assistance in Enforcement" along with copies of the enforcement officer's work credentials via judicial express mail, the bank shall provide assistance.

9. Banking financial institutions shall study and improve the bank-side online inquiry and control database to ensure that the data fed back by the online inquiry and control system is consistent with the data obtained from over-the-counter inquiries; they shall improve the performance of the bank-side online inquiry and control database to increase feedback speed and feedback rate, and to resolve the backlog of inquiry and control data; within 24 hours of receiving an online inquiry and control request initiated by the nationwide court online execution inquiry and control system, the bank shall provide effective feedback.

10. The High People's Courts of all provinces (municipalities, autonomous regions), the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and the banking regulatory bureaus of all provinces (municipalities, autonomous regions) are responsible for supervising and ensuring that local banking financial institutions within their respective jurisdictions launch the online freezing function and online deduction function for bank deposits and the online inquiry function and online freezing function for financial wealth management products on time; they are responsible for tracking and urging local banking financial institutions within their respective jurisdictions to faithfully fulfill their statutory obligation to assist in enforcement, to improve the accuracy and feedback rate of online inquiry and control information; and they shall report progress to the Supreme People's Court and the China Banking Regulatory Commission.

11. Banking financial institutions shall faithfully fulfill their statutory obligation to assist in enforcement. It is strictly prohibited to disclose case-related information to judgment debtors in violation of the law or to provide assistance to judgment debtors in evading enforcement. If personnel of people's courts or banking financial institutions violate the above provisions and cause adverse effects, they shall be held liable accordingly.

12. If any normative documents of people's courts and banking financial institutions concerning assistance in enforcement are inconsistent with this Notice, this Notice shall prevail.

The Supreme People's Court will establish with the China Banking Regulatory Commission a mechanism for supervision, notification, consultation, and inspection of online inquiry and control work, to study and resolve relevant issues encountered during implementation. Each banking regulatory bureau shall forward this Notice to its sub-bureaus and to local banking financial institutions within its jurisdiction.

March 12, 2018
